newsitem.title: USA: Calif. bill to fund class-size reductions advances.
newsitem.headline: Calif. bill to fund class-size reductions advances.

text.p: A California state Senate committee has approved a bill that would increase funding for the state's class-size reduction program, officials said on Thursday.
The Education Committee approved Senate Bill 50 by Senator Jack O'Connell, a Democrat.

The bill would increase the per pupil funding rate under the class-size reduction program for kindergarten through third grade from $650 to $800. The bill would also allow some schools to average their class sizes in order to become eligible for the class-size reduction funds.
The bill now advances to the Senate Appropriations Committee.
